meta.promptText: India mein acne wali skin ke liye 700 rupees ke andar konsa serum kharidun?

response.text:
Haan — **₹700 ke andar acne-prone skin ke liye meri first choice 2% Salicylic Acid serum** hogi, especially agar pimples, blackheads ya oily skin hai.

### Mere top picks

### [Minimalist Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹495*

### [The Derma Co. 2% Salicylic Acid Face Serum]()
*₹237*

### [The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide Anti-Acne Face Serum]()
*₹313*

### [Minimalist Niacinamide Face Serum]()
*₹237*

**1. 🥇 Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid — ~₹495**  
Active acne, blackheads aur excess oil ke liye best straightforward option. Brand ke current listing mein 30 ml ₹522 sale price se listed hai, though retailer pricing vary kar sakti hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. 🥈 The Derma Co 2% Salicylic Acid — ~₹439**  
Agar budget bachana hai, ye strong option hai. 2% salicylic acid acne aur clogged pores target karta hai. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/2-salicylic-acid-serum?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**3. ⭐ The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide — ~₹449–515**  
Agar **pimples + acne marks + oily skin** teeno hain, mujhe ye sabse balanced choice lagti hai: **2% salicylic acid + 5% niacinamide**. [thedermaco.com](https://thedermaco.com/products/sali-cinamide-anti-acne-serum-with-2-salicylic-acid-5-niacinamide-30ml?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**4. Minimalist Niacinamide 10% — ~₹237+**  
Agar active pimples se zyada **oiliness, pores aur acne marks** concern hain, niacinamide better fit ho sakta hai. [beminimalist.co](https://beminimalist.co/collections/serums-acne-acne-prone-skin?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Meri pick:**  
👉 **Active acne/blackheads:** Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid  
👉 **Acne + marks:** **The Derma Co Sali-Cinamide**  
👉 **Mostly acne marks/oily skin:** Minimalist Niacinamide

Salicylic acid serum ko initially **raat mein 2–3 baar/week** use karo, aur daytime mein **SPF 30–50 sunscreen** zaroor lagao. Ek saath multiple strong actives start mat karna.

Agar tum mujhe bata do **tumhari skin oily/dry/combination/sensitive hai aur acne kaisa hai (small bumps, pimples, blackheads ya marks)**, main ₹700 mein **exact 1 serum** choose kar dunga.
